name: Med 23 Pub
title: Med 23 Pub - Lively Bar Experience in Benidorm
description: Enjoy great drinks, a welcoming atmosphere, and friendly service at Med 23 Pub. Perfect for relaxing or a fun night out in Benidorm!
paragraphs: Located in the vibrant heart of Benidorm, Med 23 Pub is the quintessential spot for those seeking a blend of relaxation and entertainment. This popular bar on Av. de Cuenca offers a delightful escape from the bustling streets, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring this lively seaside town.

Upon stepping into Med 23 Pub, you're greeted by a charming decor that strikes the ideal balance between modern and cozy. The ambiance is inviting, making it an excellent venue for both casual meet-ups and lively gatherings with friends. As a favorite among locals and tourists alike, the pub boasts a delightful atmosphere that is often noted for its reasonable drink prices and friendly service.

The reviews highlight the commendable service that makes every visit special. Brendan McClenaghan mentions the "great service and drinks prices," complemented by a nicely designed interior, while Steve Allan describes the pub's atmosphere as great, with music playing just at the right volume. This makes it the perfect backdrop for enjoying a laid-back afternoon or an enjoyable evening out.

One of the standout features of Med 23 Pub is its impressive range of beverages. Customers rave about the spectacular value, especially in the hot weather, with Ellie B sharing her delight at a fantastic deal of five beers in an ice bucket for just €9. The pub also offers thoughtfully crafted cocktails and a selection of spirits at competitive prices, ensuring there’s something for everyone.

For sports enthusiasts, Med 23 Pub is a dream come true. With a superb pool table and screens showing popular matches, it’s the ideal place to cheer for your favorite team with fellow fans. Gary Teanby highlights it as a "great sports bar," reaffirming its status as a primary choice for sports lovers in the area.
